definitions.explanation: Eating excessively, beyond what is needed or healthy. Also used as a clinical term for binge eating in medical and psychological contexts.

examples.japanese: {過食|かしょく}は{体|からだ}に{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: Overeating is bad for your health.

examples.japanese: ストレスで{過食|かしょく}してしまう。
examples.english: I end up overeating because of stress.

examples.japanese: {過食|かしょく}と{拒食|きょしょく}を{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す{摂食障害|せっしょくしょうがい}に{悩|なや}んでいる。
examples.english: I suffer from an eating disorder that cycles between binge eating and food refusal.

notes:
Compound of {過|か} (excess) + {食|しょく} (eating). Can be used casually for general overeating, but also functions as a clinical term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {過食|かしょく}する — to overeat (する verb)
- {過食症|かしょくしょう} — binge eating disorder; bulimia
- {過食|かしょく}{嘔吐|おうと} — binge-purge cycle
- {過食|かしょく}に{走|はし}る — to turn to overeating

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {食|た}べ{過|す}ぎ — eating too much (everyday expression)
- {暴飲暴食|ぼういんぼうしょく} — eating and drinking excessively
- {拒食|きょしょく} — food refusal, anorexia (opposite)
